title: New Formula Burned My Skin
date: Bewertet in den USA am5. Dezember 2022
review: Use at your own risk!  It can take MONTHS before you see a reaction, and take months to heal.I bought my first bottle and didn't have any issues.  It worked great.Then I bought a second bottle and after about 2 months of daily use, I started to notice flaking around my mouth.  The dryness and flaking gradually worsened, but I didn't think it was the Bioderma that was causing it because I had used an entire bottle prior to the bottle I was using and had no issues.  I thought it was something else causing my reaction so I kept using the Bioderma.It took me two more months to figure out it was the Bioderma causing my reaction.  By then, my eyes were affected:  swollen, red, and itchy.It's been two months since I stopped using it and I'm marginally better.  At this rate of healing, it's probably going to take 6 months before I'm completely healed.  It's as if the oil burned deep into the skin and as my skin renews itself, the burned layers are coming to the surface and sloughing off.  LOTS of dead skin sloughing off.I do not have sensitive skin, and I have NEVER had this type of reaction to any skin product before.Bioderma had to have changed their formula or I got a very expired bottle that turned toxic.  I recommended this to another person and she got the same result, so I'm absolutely certain Bioderma caused my skin problems.Again, the symptoms take a while to show up, and it takes a long time for the damage to surface and slough away.

title: INCONSISTENT QUALITY, NOT GOOD FOR FACE
date: Bewertet in den USA am7. Dezember 2025
review: I really was excited to try this cleansing oil! I really read a lot of reviews on it, Read a lot of research on cleansing oils their self as I have been dealing with a lot of dry, oily rough skin on my face with darker spots starting to show . As far as the overproduction of sebum…. I read that it could be due to my face being dry. After reading other people’s reviews on the cleansing oil, I was really hopeful that this oil would help my face become less dry, which would prevent over production of sebum creating less issues. I ordered two bottles. That is how excited I was!!! I put the first bottle in my shower and the second bottle in our second bathroom that I normally will shower in a couple times a week. The consistency of the oil in the first bottle was a lot thicker and lathered when water was applied very well and it took alot less than the second bottle. The oil on the second bottle was very watery before water was applied and didn’t really lather up as the other bottle! I’m really not sure what’s going on there. I ordered the second bottle about a week after I ordered the first bottle and I paid almost double the price! I’m not too happy that I paid double the price for a bottle that was half the quality.Now onto how the oil worked… after doing some research on how to properly use the oil, I applied the oil to my dry skin prior to getting into the shower. In the shower I rinsed it off really well then used a Dove beauty bar to ensure that there was no residue left behind us that can clog pores. After the first use, my skin was very soft. I didn’t feel like I needed to put lotion on or any moisturizer!!! I was so excited about it that I told my husband he had to try it!! After about a week… I started breaking out A Lot on my face, chest and back. my husband did as well!!! I continued using it for a few weeks as I know that sometimes when using something new on your face, it takes a week or two to get all the impurities out of your skin however, I continued to break out!!! I’m not sure which bottle was causing the breakout if it was one or the other or both. As I mentioned before the consistency of the oil was completely different in each bottle. So I stopped using it on my face and I only use it to shave my legs and armpits now! I have no issues with it, breaking my legs or my armpits out, but I will not use it on my face or upper body anymore as every time I do or my husband does we get breakout! I’m giving it three stars because it’s great to use to shave but I would NOT recommend for anyone for their face. I’m sure not. Everyone has issues with it Breaking their face out. my husband and I did have those issues and I gave it a chance for a few weeks. Everyone skin is different. I just think it’s notable to advise of the differences of consistency in the two bottles that I bought a week apart one was a rich, oily consistency that lathered really well when water was applied.  The other bottle was really watery and did not lather well when water was applied. I do know my daughter uses it and she has not had any complaints about the second bottle that is in my opinion worse quality… I would not say that I wouldn’t buy it again. I just would not buy it again for the purpose that I bought it originally!  I do not think the second bottle was worth over $30 that I paid. The first bottle in the quality of that first bottle was way more worth what I paid for it.

title: Strong Fragrance
review: Lot of good things about this cleansing oil.- Cleansing oils are very gentle and this is a good one. Very good for dry skin.- Washes cleaner than other oil's I've used.- Niacinamide tells your body to hurry up and replenish your skins lipid barrier. Takes time and consistency to work but the result's speak for themselves.- Skin Barrier Therapy tech help's prevent Staph bacteria from adhering to skin.- Great value! 1L for $33CAD and refills for $25CAD is unmatched for this quality of cleansing oil.I bought this product mainly for the Skin Barrier Therapy tech to help prevent Staph from aggravating my eczema. It also seemed like a good long term very gentle cleanser in a value for money sense.Unfortunately I doubt I'll buy another bottle. Why? Mainly its got a strong fragrance.Typically for eczema, fragrance free is what you should be buying. Fragrances are frequently cited as one of the top causes of allergic contact dermatitis.People claimed that this product's fragrance is exceptionally gentle, and to its credit it hasn't appeared to aggravate my eczema so far. I'd still prefer a fragrance free option and frankly it's so much more potent than I expected. If you're used to fragranced product's maybe this is normal for you, I don't know, but as a guy with eczema all of my product's are fragrance free so this is taking some getting used to.People in review's said it's a gender neutral scent but honestly it smells like women's perfume to me. There's nothing wrong with that and it's not a bad scent per se, but it's both too strong for my liking and not the kind of scent I like smelling on my body. It is a scent that doesn't wash off and sticks around.I originally bought this to use on my whole body including face, but I had to stop using it on my face in particular because of the scent. I doubt I'll buy another bottle once this is empty.One final note: While it is lightly foaming, it doesn't foam as much as I'd hoped. I think the issue is that I was previously using La Roche Posay Lipikar Oil AP+ (fragrance free) and that product in particular foam's a fair bit. That is at least by oil standards, the AP+ Syndet foams more than the AP+ Oil. The Bioderm is harder to spread on the hairy part's of my body.I would love for this company to develop a fragrance free version of this product!

title: Whoa nelly!
date: Bewertet in den USA am2. Dezember 2020
review: My skin gets really dry in winter. I apply baby oil as a moisturizer to my skin and it worked so I decided to try a cleansing oil to see if that would help even further. First of all, the bottle was leaking when I received it. It’s a bit of a hassle since now I have product all over that I need to clean up. The bottle itself doesn’t open, unlike other bottles where you can twist the cap off. I agree with other reviewers saying that the scent is strong. When I first tried it in the shower, an overwhelming floral scent hit me like a ton of bricks. Like, whoa nelly! It was the strong old lady floral scent, the kind that can give you a headache. I applied the oil to my wet skin and it doesn’t really lather which was a bummer. It took a couple of pumps to wash my whole body so I’m not really sure how long this bottle will last. Now that my skin is dry, I can still smell that floral scent. It’s not as strong but it is still noticeable. I am thinking since it is quite a new fragrance, my senses are still kind of sensitive to it. Maybe after a couple of days, I’ll get used to it. I also tried washing my face with this and the texture is thicker than my typical cleansing oil from Origins. I think I’m sticking with Origins for my face. All in all, it’s not bad but it’s not super amazing either. Will continue using to see if it will at least help me get thru winter without having to scratch my skin off.
